Method of Attack: Malicious Word document with macros that execute PowerShell commands to download and execute the Emotet banking Trojan
Attack Vector: Phishing email disguised as Amazon order confirmation with malicious Word document attachment; user interaction required to enable macros in the Word document
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject lines like 'Your Amazon.com order', 'Amazon order details', 'Your order 162-2672000-0034071 has shipped'
Compromised servers located in Columbia, Indonesia, and the United States
